title: Seagull Killer
description: A button that kills seagulls from the Alex Mobs mod
body:
In this mod it adds 2 buttons which let you remove the seagulls from your surroundings

The first button has a radius of 48 blocks around the player to kill all the seagulls

![Normal Seagull Button](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4aee30a824791351362294a48d7f07a3f86f30a0.png)

And the second button can kill all the seagulls in the world.

![Infinite Seagull Button](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f2bd5f9cb29087a3669915704fe3f489bb535f9c.png)
